issue.body:
This issue was originally reported against [Fedora](https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2308835).

I was able to reduce it to:
- LLVM IR: https://godbolt.org/z/dqa91xzv1
- C: https://godbolt.org/z/jbxnvx7o6

The C source code is:
```c
#define simde_math_roundeven(v) __builtin_roundeven(v)
#define SIMDE_VECTOR(size) __attribute__((__vector_size__(size)))

typedef double simde_float64;
typedef struct {
  simde_float64 f64 SIMDE_VECTOR(64);
} simde__m512d_private;

simde__m512d_private __trans_tmp_4, test_simde_x_mm512_round_pd_r_;

void simde__m512d_from_private();

void test_simde_x_mm512_round_pd() {
  for (int i;;) {
    simde__m512d_private a_ = __trans_tmp_4;
    i = 0;
    for (; i < sizeof(test_simde_x_mm512_round_pd_r_.f64[0]); i++)
      test_simde_x_mm512_round_pd_r_.f64[i] = simde_math_roundeven(a_.f64[i]);
    simde__m512d_from_private();
  }
}
```

The issue can be reproduced with the command: `clang -O2 round-reduced.c`

comments.body: It doesn't have the pattern for froundeven in PPCInstrVSX.td. I am not sure which vsx instruction could be matched to froundeven operation.

comments.author: tuliom
comments.body: Reminder: code that was not vectorized is successfully built and calls `roundeven()` provided by the math library.

comments.author: stefanp-synopsys
comments.body: Okay, we should take a look at this. The PPC backend should support this even if it requires multiple instructions.

comments.author: lei137
comments.body:
`xvrdpic` - VSX Vector Round to Double-Precision Integer Exact using Current rounding mode and `xvrspic` (SP) seem to be the best fit.  FPSCR need to be set/reset to round to nearest even (FPSCR.RN=0b00) since these instructions respond to the prevailing rounding mode.  There are other vector round to integer instructions but apparently none specific to round to nearest even.

[Accessing the floating point environment](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/UsersManual.html#accessing-the-floating-point-environment) seems to suggest we can assume the default rounding mode (round to nearest even) for `xvrdpic` and `xvrspic` unless one of these pragmas are set 
```
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
#pragma STDC FENV_ROUND FE_DYNAMIC
```
In which case we have to set/restore the rounding mode before/after `xvrdpic` or `xvrspic`.

Not sure if there are also options to sets the floating point env that need to be taken into consideration.

comments.author: nikic
comments.body: I've put up a fix for the legalization failure at https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/150597. Having a more optimized lowering for this would certainly be nice, but there is no reason to crash in the meantime, we just need to scalarize the unsupported operation.

issue.title: powerpc64le: ICE during instruction selection

tests.test_body:
define void @test(ptr %p1, ptr %p2) nounwind {
  %v = load <8 x double>, ptr %p1, align 64
  %res = call <8 x double> @llvm.roundeven.v8f64(<8 x double> %v)
  store <8 x double> %res, ptr %p2, align 64
  ret void
}

declare <8 x double> @llvm.roundeven.v8f64(<8 x double>)
